rubric_definition: After you make the edit that one reviewer is asking for, does the other reviewer's comment still stand? If it is discharged too, the two findings are one defect; if it survives, they are different defects that share a location. If a reviewer offers two alternative fixes, either one discharging the other comment makes it one defect. Contradictory prescriptions to the same lines are different defects, because no single edit satisfies both.
evidence: Finding A concerns safeFilename in export-utils.ts not stripping control/bidi characters from download filenames; Finding B concerns a line break in a markdown doc making "Modern Writer" look like two theme names. Different files, different defects, and neither fix discharges the other.

panel.summary: `safeFilename` (now also used for .pptx) strips only Windows-reserved punctuation, not control characters or bidi overrides
panel.evidence: The sanitizer is `(title || "").replace(/[\\/:*?"<>|]+/g, "_")` (export-utils.ts:151), so a document title containing U+202E (RTL override), other bidi controls, or C0 control characters survives into the `a.download` value at export-utils.ts:65. A deck titled with an RLO can render in the download shelf/file manager with a visually reversed name (classic extension-spoofing presentation), though the real on-disk extension is still forced to `.pptx`.
